description: A callout for a message the user should notice where it is shown: a failed save, a confirmation that something worked, a warning about a setting. Only the destructive variant interrupts a screen reader.

variant.description: Visual and live-region emphasis. destructive announces assertively; success, warning, and default announce politely.

handled: role="alert" (assertive) is set for variant="destructive"; other variants get role="status" (polite) so a confirmation does not interrupt the screen reader
An author-provided role is always left alone

required.requirement: Include slot="title" or slot="description" so assistive tech has content to announce. Colour alone is not a sufficient signal.

required.when: role is set on the alert to anything but its variant's own (alert for destructive, status otherwise)
required.requirement: Remove the role and let the variant set it: role="alert" for destructive, which interrupts the screen reader, and role="status" for the rest, which waits its turn.

counterExamples.reason: variant="error" is not valid. Use variant="destructive" for error states.
Alerts are non-interactive surfaces. For acknowledgeable prompts use aihio-dialog.
role="alert" interrupts the screen reader. A confirmation should announce politely — drop the role and let the success variant set role="status".
